messages:
Alex (AE): Hey team — RedwoodX just asked to expand the POC scope. Originally we were doing hosted API intent extraction + embeddings, but they now want: private deployment option, encrypt-at-rest + HSM key flow, and an additional prompt/eval suite for 10 more intents. They're asking for updated success criteria, timeline, and a pricing delta. Can SE/SRE/security weigh in?

Chris (SE): Thanks Alex. Can you confirm the primary KPIs they care about? latency, throughput, accuracy? Also do they want private in the 6-week POC window or as a follow-up?

Alex (AE): KPIs from customer call: p95 latency <200ms for short-turn prompts (~50 tokens), throughput ~20 qps bursty (avg ~5 qps), expected token volume ~500k tokens/day. Accuracy target: intent classification F1 >= 0.95 on their eval set. They said they want to see private deployment viability within the POC if possible.

Maya (SRE): Private in the POC adds infra/time. Quick reality check: staging private (VPC + VPN + KMS integration) — 2–3 extra weeks for infra + security sign-off. If we stage it, we should do hosted baseline first, then private spike.

Samir (Security): For HSM/KMS flow we need their KMS endpoint details and compliance requirements (SOC2, FedRAMP? any additional controls). Also need to know if they require zero-exfiltration air-gapped option. I'll start a security questionnaire but need answers to: 1) required key custodianship model, 2) audit retention window, 3) network egress policy.

Chris (SE): Proposal for staged POC:
1) Week 0-2: Hosted API baseline + ingest their eval set (we run generation + classification flows). Establish accuracy and latency baselines.
2) Week 3-4: Perf tuning (batching, KV cache, model selection/quantization) to hit latency/throughput.
3) Week 5-6: Private deploy spike (lightweight VM/GPU + KMS). If private can't be fully provisioned, demo config & infra runbook and replay with synthetic traffic.

Chris (SE): Example prompt evaluation snippet we will run (they send 1k labeled samples):
```
# eval config
model: redwood-optimized-13b
actions: generate_intent -> classifier
metrics: accuracy, f1, latency_p95
batch_size: 4
```

Alex (AE): Customer also asked pricing delta. They asked: "how much extra for private + HSM during POC?" Also want an estimate for Dedicated capacity monthly pricing if they buy after POC.

Evan (Product): Pricing quick take: short-term POC private spike (one-off infra + engineering) — recommend quoting a fixed services fee ~USD 22k-35k depending on scope (HSM integration ups cost). Dedicated monthly commit depends on GPU profile; rough ballpark for their throughput: USD 8k-12k/month for mid-tier Dedicated, plus storage & observability add-ons. I'll craft a formal quote after SE/SRE confirm infra needs.

Samir (Security): For the questionnaire: can Alex loop in customer security contact? We need the responses to these items ASAP. If they require HSM-backed key material managed in their KMS, we need network connectivity + key rotation policy. If they insist on HSM on-prem, that's a longer lead (hardware & provisioning).

Alex (AE): Looping in customer sec: @customer-sec (copied to email). They're good to answer. I'll ask for KMS endpoint and if SOC2 + encryption-in-transit is sufficient or if they require FIPS/HSM.

Maya (SRE): Blocker note: If we try private POC on their VPC, we need IAM rules and a firewall window. Also need to decide if we deploy with our private control plane or fully customer-managed control plane. Customer-managed increases checklist (bootstrap scripts, agent, certs).

Chris (SE): To limit scope creep I'd suggest: define MUST vs NICE-TO-HAVE acceptance criteria. MUST: 95% F1 on provided eval, p95 latency <200ms hosted after tuning. NICE: HSM in POC, air-gapped option. If MUST fail, we stop and propose next steps.

Alex (AE): Customer accepts MUST/NICE separation. They want an updated SOW with those bullets and price. Can someone draft a short SOW + pricing delta we can send today?

Evan (Product): I'll draft SOW language for staged POC and cost bands. Chris/Maya — I'll include a technical appendix you can edit.

Chris (SE): I'll add eval details and minimal infra spec. Quick infra snippet for private spike:
```
# minimal private spike infra
1 x A10G or A16 (or equivalent) GPU node
4 vCPU, 32GB RAM
10GB SSD for model cache
KMS: customer endpoint + mutual-TLS
VPN: IP allowlist for control plane
```

Samir (Security): Add to appendix: logging retention 90 days (default), audit hooks to push audit logs to their SIEM via syslog/HTTPS. Also include runbook for key compromise.

Alex (AE): One more blocker: legal asked about data residency. Customer requires EU-only data storage for PII. They want confirmation we can pin their data to eu-west region.

Maya (SRE): We can pin to eu-west-hosted for hosted POC. Private in-customer VPC obviously stays in their region. Note: model caching across regions not supported for a single POC instance — call that out.

Evan (Product): Agreed. I'll add region pinning to SOW and a note about cache behavior.

Alex (AE): Ok owners: Evan -> SOW + pricing draft (EOD), Chris -> technical appendix + eval plan (tomorrow noon), Maya -> infra playbook + timeline estimate (tomorrow EOD), Samir -> security questionnaire + list of required customer artifacts (tomorrow EOB). I'll coordinate with customer.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `poc-spike-deploy-checklist` for 2025-08-12 08:00 UTC (placeholder).

Chris (SE): One last thought on pricing: if they convert to Dedicated after POC, we should offer a credit for the POC services fee against first 3 months of Dedicated commit (e.g., credit up to $15k). Helps reduce friction.

Alex (AE): I'll offer that credit in the proposal. Customer expects response in 48 hours.

Samir (Security): I'll draft a short conditional acceptance clause for security so we don't commit to HSM-on-prem without a change order.

Maya (SRE): Noted — also add a contingency for timeline slips if customer is slow to provide KMS details or network access.

Alex (AE): Thanks all. I'll send interim note to customer flagging staged plan and expected delta + that we'll follow up with SOW within 48h.

Chris (SE): Great. I'll start preparing the eval harness and a small script to auto-run the 1k sample set and collect latency and F1.

Evan (Product): Draft SOW ready and pushed to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/poc-sow/redwoodx (please review).

Alex (AE): Confirmed — got it. Wrapping up, next sync if customer accepts will be Fri.

Maya (SRE): If anyone needs infra creds to test the private spike, ping me and I'll provision a short-lived test env.
